name: jv-for-office
description: JVision for Office — 任務窗格增益集，讓 AI 直接讀寫使用者當下開啟的檔案。目前支援 Excel；PowerPoint 與 Word 規劃中，見 docs/multi-host.md。

scripts.validate: office-addin-manifest validate manifests/excel.xml && office-addin-manifest validate manifests/word.xml
scripts.test: node test/script-guard.test.mjs && node test/undo-snapshot.test.mjs && node test/fit-layout.test.mjs && node test/clean-data.test.mjs && node test/overview-shapes.test.mjs && node test/word-chart.test.mjs && node test/word-equation.test.mjs && node test/word-paragraph.test.mjs && node test/word-table.test.mjs && node test/word-outline.test.mjs && node test/ppt-arrange.test.mjs && node test/svg-chart.test.mjs && node test/ppt-build.test.mjs && node test/no-duplicates.test.mjs
